# Harbour Plaza Hotels & Resorts

> > Harbour Plaza is a hotel group operating luxury properties across Hong Kong and Shanghai, featuring signature dining experiences, accommodation services, and online shopping platforms for hotel packages and restaurant promotions.

The website serves as the digital hub for Harbour Plaza's hotel portfolio, with properties including Harbour Plaza Metropolis in Hong Kong and Harbour Plaza Metropolitan in Shanghai. Visitors can explore hotel facilities, book accommodations, and purchase dining vouchers through dedicated eShop platforms.

## Key Topics

- Victoria Harbour
- Harbour Plaza Metropolis Hong Kong
- Harbour Plaza Metropolitan Shanghai
- Promenade Restaurant
- Senzuru Japanese Restaurant
- Café Metro
- Hotel dining & buffet promotions
- Afternoon tea experiences
- Japanese cuisine
- Hotel accommodation packages
- Restaurant vouchers & deals
- Hong Kong luxury hotels
- Shanghai business hotels
- Hotel eShop platforms

## Hong Kong Properties

- [Harbour Plaza Metropolis Hong Kong – Official eShop](https://eshop.harbour-plaza.com/metropolis/en/home): Official eShop for Harbour Plaza Metropolis with dining & buffet deals
- [Harbour Plaza Metropolis Hong Kong – Official eShop](https://eshop.harbour-plaza.com/metropolis/?p=25): Harbour Plaza Metropolis eShop featuring restaurant promotions & deals

## Shanghai Properties

- [Harbour Plaza Metropolitan Shanghai](https://www.harbour-plaza.com/metropolitan-shanghai/en/): Harbour Plaza Metropolitan Shanghai hotel accommodations & facilities
